$comment: nodes=modules, edges=[cause,effect] where cause is imported-by effect. ADD invariants by hand.

invariants.tenant_isolation: Every memory write and read query must explicitly restrict scope using a validated tenant_id (never query without a namespace filter).
invariants.privacy_deletion_guarantee: A DELETE admission action or user deletion request must physically purge vector and relational records from storage (soft-delete flags are forbidden for privacy deletion).
invariants.retrieval_performance: Retrieval operations must execute without blocking on intermediate LLM calls (deterministic hybrid search and RRF only) and complete in < 150ms.
invariants.token_budget_per_turn: Context injection per turn must never exceed the configured zone budget; budgets are enforced (a hard cap), not aspirational.
invariants.pii_pre_post_guardrail: PII and sensitive content must be prevented at admission AND at retrieval/injection (pre- and post-guards); no sensitive content may reach model context.
